stories.summary: Iran-backed Iraqi group sets 10 conditions for disarmament, including full US withdrawal Kataib Sayyid al-Shuhada, an Iran -backed Iraqi armed group, said on Saturday it will only cooperate with efforts to bring weapons under state control if 10 conditions are met, including a complete withdrawal of US forces from Iraq. The group said US forces must fully withdraw by land, sea and air, that any American presence “under any title” must end, and that Iraqi airspace must not be used to launch attacks on neighbouring countries. stories.title: Drop Shot EP 09 | Once More, Incels, Art Deco & Yash’s Toxic Fairy Tale
stories.summary: In this episode, we bring together four stories from the worlds of cinema, culture, society and Chennai’s history. Arjun Das and Aditi Shankar talk about Once More and choosing stories that connect with them. Writer Meena Kandasamy examines the world of the Indian incel and the ideas behind it. We step inside the Art Deco story of The Hindu’s iconic Chennai building, and look at Yash and Geetu Mohandas’ Toxic, a dark fairy tale for grown-ups.
